content.purpose: Reach the same location regardless of the shell’s starting directory.
content.mentalModel: An absolute path begins with / and is resolved from the root of the filesystem, so the current directory cannot change its meaning.

demonstration.explanation: This small example isolates the main idea behind absolute paths.

remember: An absolute path begins with / and is resolved from the root of the filesystem, so the current directory cannot change its meaning.

tasks.instruction: From any starting location, use an absolute path to reach /usr/share/doc and record pwd in /home/student/answers/absolute-path.txt.
hints: Absolute paths always begin at the root directory.
Use cd with the full path beginning with /.
Record pwd after reaching the documentation directory.
